entry.author: RNZ
entry.summary:
A video has been circulating social media of the marked Police car driving along the road while a video of what appears to be a FIFA match is played on a screen on the dashboard | Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/RNZVideo?sub_confirmation=1

Police say the driver of a marked Police car seen playing a video while driving has come forward and been issued with an infringement notice.

"Police apologise for this incident, and we acknowledge the concern this may have caused," Inspector MinHo Lee of Counties Manukau Central Police said.

Video: Checkpoint Watch Auckland Facebook Group

Full story: https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/regions/617562/officer-caught-watching-a-video-while-driving-police-car
